why: Round 7 text was NOT_CONFIRMED (11/30), but its only stable arm, l_out-11 last token, passed 6/6 on a 72-episode test from three topics. Round 9 repeats exactly that arm, unchanged, on a larger never-used test. It decides whether text-action outcomes can join the tool forecast later; it changes no runtime.
reserve_rule: as rounds 3/7 (unchanged round-3 generate): a topic with fewer than 16 parsed sentences is skipped, the next reserve in order is tried, generation stops at 8 accepted topics or when the reserve is exhausted

pipeline.generate: scripts/action_jepa_round3.py generate, C3 LFM2.5-350M-QAD-Q4_0 (sha 3d10b6ab…), llama-server b10964 release (sha 79e31218…), temperature 0, unchanged
pipeline.capture_mean_final: scripts/action_jepa_round3.py capture, B2 Qwen3.5-0.8B-Q4_0 (sha 57d19977…), unchanged (the round-3 export needs it; not trained here)

tap_tool.build: clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 against the pinned llama.cpp b10964 source headers and release libraries (same command as scripts/test_tool_forecast_phone.build_taps)
tap_tool.note: Not the round-7 capture build (c00d6829…); the whole corpus is recaptured with this one build so train and test share an encoder.

gates: round-6 gates unchanged (predictive .98 x min(copy, mean_delta, shuffled) per action on calibration and test; per-action retention delta 0; normal equations; finite; deterministic; reload; noncollapse; observed input)
decision_rule: Per run: pass only if all gates hold. Family: CONFIRMED if more than half of the 6 runs pass (>= 4), otherwise NOT_CONFIRMED. No grid, gate, topic or script change after this registration; fewer accepted topics are reported as a deviation, not a reason to rerun. A confirmed family supports only "a fixed mean-delta base plus a learned ridge residual on frozen l_out-11 last-token native taps predicts C3 text-action outcomes on unseen topics better than the controls"; no runtime, receiver or phone claim, and no claim about semantic quality.
report_only: per-action test ratio to the best control; retention deltas; accepted topics and test episode count
not_changed: No file under code/v13/ changed; no runtime, receiver or learn authority.
